pairs: Why have the Gentiles been seething,
and why have the people been pondering nonsense?
The kings of the earth have stood up,
et principes convenerunt in unum adversus Dominum,
and the leaders have joined together as one,
against the Lord and against his Christ:
et projiciamus a nobis jugum ipsorum.
and cast their yoke away from us.”
Qui habitat in cælis irridebit eos,
He who dwells in heaven will ridicule them,
and the Lord will mock them.
Tunc loquetur ad eos in ira sua,
Then will he speak to them in his anger
et in furore suo conturbabit eos.
and trouble them with his fury.
Ego autem constitutus sum rex ab eo super Sion,
Yet I have been appointed king by him over Zion,
The Lord has said to me:
this day have I begotten you.
Ask of me and I will give to you:
et dabo tibi gentes hæreditatem tuam,
and the ends of the earth for your possession.
You will rule them with an iron rod,
et tamquam vas figuli confringes eos.
and you will shatter them like a potter’s vessel.
and exult in him with trembling.
lest at any time the Lord might become angry,
and you would perish from the way of the just.
Cum exarserit in brevi ira ejus,
Though his wrath can flare up in a short time,
beati omnes qui confidunt in eo.
blessed are all those who trust in him.
